text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Today, Mimi and {0} are out searching for bunnies.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ミミと{0}は
うさぎを探しにおでかけしていた。

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text: Eeky squeaky, purrrrrr!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぷぷぷっぷ、
きゅるきゅる～

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text:
See, if you make bunny sounds like this,
the bunnies won't be scared to come out!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こうやって、
うさぎさんのマネしてれば、
うさぎさんもこわがらないよ～

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text: You do it too, mister!
text_block_list.orig_text: おにいちゃんも、やって～！

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text:
Ooh!
You're good at this, mister!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うわぁ～！
おにいちゃん、じょうず、じょうず～！

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, mister!
I know you've got it in you to be the cutest bunny!
text_block_list.orig_text:
だいじょうぶだよ～
おにいちゃんなら、
かわいいうさぎさんになれるよ～

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, mister, let's do it together!
Eeky squeaky, purrrrr!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おにいちゃん、
一緒にやろ～
ぷぷぷっぷ、
きゅるきゅる～

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text:
Eheheh!
Now we're sure to find lots of bunnies, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
えへへ～
これなら、
すぐにうさぎさん出てきてくれるよね？

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text:
You know, when I find a bunny,
I'm gonna pet his fluffy little body all over!
Ahhh, I hope we find one soon!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ミミね、
うさぎさんとあえたら、
いっぱい、
もふもふふかふかするんだ～
はやくあいたいな～

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text:
Fluffy-fluffy cuddly little bunny friends~♪
Come on out with a hoppity-hop~!♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
もふもふ、もふもふ、うさぎさん～♪
はやく出てきて、ぴょんぴょこぴょ～ん♪

text_block_list.text: Eeky squeaky, purrrrrr!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぷぷぷっぷ、
きゅるきゅる～

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh! Did you hear that, mister?
That sounded like a real bunny voice!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ！　
おにいちゃん、
きいた？
いまの、
うさぎさんのなきごえだよ～

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text:
It came from over in the woods!
Let's go see!
text_block_list.orig_text:
森の中からきこえたよ。
いってみよ～！

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, mister, over here!
Mr. Bunny! Wait for me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おにいちゃん、
こっちこっち～！
うさぎさん、
まって～！

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh?!
You're... a monster!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わ！？
ま、
魔物さんだ！？

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: Eeky squeaky, purrrrrr!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぷぷぷっぷ、
きゅるきゅる～

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text:
...Huh?!
Then that voice... It was your voice all along, Mr. Monster...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……え！？
このなきごえ、
魔物さんの声だったの……

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text:
So it wasn't a bunny at all...
I really thought I'd found one, too...
Aaahhh...
text_block_list.orig_text:
うさぎさんじゃなかったよ～
やっとみつけたと思ったのに……
ふぇぇ……

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What's wrong, mister? Is something the matter?
Look behind the monster...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？　
おにいちゃん、
どうしたの？
魔物さんの後ろ……？

text_block_list.name: Mini-Gryphon
text_block_list.text: Eeky squeaky, purrrrrr!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぷぷぷっぷ、
きゅるきゅる～

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GROOOAAARGHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text:
Ahhhh! The bunny voice again!
So it was [i]your[/i] voice, Mr. Mini-Gryphon!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ～、
うさぎさんのなきごえ！
プチグリフォンさんの声だったんだね～

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text:
But what's going on?
Mr. Mini-Gryphon's face looks all sad somehow...
text_block_list.orig_text:
どうしたんだろ～？
プチグリフォンさん、
悲しそうなお顔してるよ～？

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text:
I'll see if I can find out what's wrong!
Eeky squeaky, purrrrr!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ミミが、
お話きいてみるね？
ぷぷぷっぷ、
きゅるきゅる～

text_block_list.name: Mini-Gryphon
text_block_list.text: Eeky squeaky, purrrrrr!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぷぷぷっぷ、
きゅるきゅる～

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text:
Whaaaa?! O-oh no, this is bad!
Mr. Mini-Gryphon needs our help!
He says this nasty monster was bullying him!
text_block_list.orig_text:
えぇ！？　
　
た、
大変、大変～！
たすけてって言ってるよ～
この魔物さんにいじめられてるみたい。

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text:
I sure can!
When he eeky-squeaks, I get a feeling like,
\"This is probably what he means!\"
text_block_list.orig_text:
できるよ～♪
こんなこと話してるんだろうな～って、
わかるもん～♪

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text:
It's true!
Go on, why don't you ask him yourself?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほんとだよ～！
あ、
おにいちゃんもきいてみれば～？

text_block_list.name: Mini-Gryphon
text_block_list.text: Eeky squeaky, purrrrrr!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぷぷぷっぷ、
きゅるきゅる～

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text:
See?
\"I'm scared! Help me! The monster's going to gobble me up!
Help me, Mimi, Mr. Nice Guy!\" You heard him say that, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ね？
「こわいよ～！　たすけて～！　
たべられちゃうよ～！
ミミちゃん、おにいちゃん～！」って、
いってたでしょ？

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text:
We've gotta save Mr. Mini-Gryphon!
Mr. Monster's pretty scary...
But we can't let him be a big bully!
text_block_list.orig_text:
プチグリフォンさんをたすけてあげなきゃっ！
魔物さんはこわいけど……
いじめはしちゃいけないんだよ～！

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You're gonna help out too, mister?
Thanks!
Let's save Mr. Mini-Gryphon together!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふぇ？　
おにいちゃんも手伝ってくれるの？
ありがと～！
一緒にプチグリフォンさんをたすけてあげよ～

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: RRRRUAAAARGHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text:
Yayyyy!
Mr. Monster ran away!
text_block_list.orig_text:
やった～！
魔物さんがにげていくよ～

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text:
I don't think I could've been so brave
without you helping me, mister!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おにいちゃんがてつだってくれたから、
ミミ、がんばれたよ～！

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text: Now nobody will be able to hurt Mr. Mini-Gryphon anymore!
text_block_list.orig_text:
プチグリフォンさんも、
これで安心だね～

text_block_list.name: Mini-Gryphon
text_block_list.text: Eeky squeaky, purrrrrr!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぷぷぷっぷ、
きゅるきゅる～♪

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! That tickles!
But... you're so fluffy and snuggly...!
It feels lovely!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あはは、
くすぐったいよ～
でも、
もふもふ、
ふかふか～♪
きもちいいよ～

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
It looks like the Mini-Gryphon has taken quite a liking
to its diminutive savior.
text_block_list.orig_text: 助けたことで、すっかりなつかれてしまったミミであった。
